source_authority.workflow_concurrency_rule: one current run per pull request or branch; exact source SHA verified inside every job

authority_owned.closure_rule: Only real authority-issued, Ed25519-authenticated, externally pinned and independently accepted evidence can change an inherited row to CLOSED_VERIFIED.

claim_ceiling: G9 source and exact-head CI can establish E0-E4 only; E5-E7, administrative and upstream claims require their named authorities
